sections.title: Further robust procedures and joint endpoint qualifications

missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-huber-remaining-methods-C007 (partial): Its declared status is proved=annex:p15.huber.cdf.domain, but the full proof it promises is not supplied for every assertion. The theorem (handbook/parts/p15/huber-remaining-methods.tex lines 349-350) asserts that 'smoothing alone need not preserve the original CDF bound', i.e. that Gaussian smoothing of some member of K_eps can leave K_eps. The annex proof (handbook/annex/p15/huber-remaining-methods.tex lines 329-389, construction at 356-370) only proves that mixing with Phi and then smoothing with s<=pi*delta*eps stays inside K_eps. Its only smoothing estimate is an upper bound, sup|E Phi(x-sZ)-Phi(x)|<=s/pi. No example or argument anywhere on the route shows that smoothing alone fails, so this asserted case is unproved. The rest of the theorem is proved: convexity, vague compactness, mass at least 1-2eps, and vague density of finite-information members.
